_comment: Tier-2 for febio::elasticity_mms#1. Doubling <density> alone on the generated MMS deck: both runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning; every prescribed boundary node is unchanged to the last digit because they are Dirichlet; and the interior displacement scales by the density ratio. The boundary/interior split is the assertion — a uniform rescaling could be divided back out, and this is not one, which is why the error survives a smoke test. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'mms_density_coupling=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
